newsitem.title: USA: Clinton expected to name Sperling NEC head.
newsitem.headline: Clinton expected to name Sperling NEC head.

text.p: President Clinton was expected to name Gene Sperling, a 38-year-old economic policy adviser, to head the National Economic Council, administration sources said.
Sperling, who is known for his 20-hour workdays and single-minded focus on the political ramifications of economic actions, would succeed Laura Tyson in the prestigious post.
The sources said Clinton was expected to announce Sperling's selection at a 1400 EST/1900 GMT White House news conference.
